8bc039a8-36ee-496e-b512-aaf171b0ebd7.name: Plan and design template

informationProduced.purpose: Systematic investigation of multiple repositories to answer research questions. Allows users to investigate patterns, implementations, and gather information across multiple codebases in a structured way.
useCases: Investigating how features are implemented across microservices

required.name: researchQuestion
required.description: The specific question or investigation goal to answer across repositories
required.example: How is authentication implemented across our microservices?

required.name: repositories
required.description: List of repository paths or workspace folders to investigate (comma-separated or array)

optional.name: investigationScope
optional.description: Specific areas or patterns to focus on (e.g., authentication, error handling, API patterns)

optional.name: filePatterns
optional.description: File patterns to search within each repository

optional.name: outputFormat
optional.description: Desired output format for findings (markdown, json, comparative-table)

stepBreakdown.name: Understand investigation context
stepBreakdown.output: Context documentation with research question, repositories, scope
stepBreakdown.rationale: Existing step handles parameter gathering and clarification - fits perfectly for establishing investigation context

stepBreakdown.name: Gather repository information
stepBreakdown.output: Repository catalog with metadata for each repo
stepBreakdown.rationale: NEW STEP NEEDED: No existing step handles multi-repo enumeration, validation, and metadata gathering. Searched planning/, investigation/, common/ - none handle multiple workspace contexts.

stepBreakdown.name: Investigate across repositories
stepBreakdown.output: Per-repository findings with patterns, implementations, and examples
stepBreakdown.rationale: NEW STEP NEEDED: No existing step handles parallel investigation across multiple codebases with aggregation. Identify-files is single-repo focused, review-verify-document doesn't handle multi-repo aggregation.

stepBreakdown.name: Compare and synthesize findings
stepBreakdown.output: Comparative analysis, patterns across repos, differences, recommendations
stepBreakdown.rationale: NEW STEP NEEDED: No existing step performs cross-repository pattern comparison and synthesis. Final-summary is for single investigation, not comparative analysis.

stepBreakdown.name: Create investigation report
stepBreakdown.output: Comprehensive investigation report in specified format
stepBreakdown.rationale: NEW STEP NEEDED: Needs multi-repo specific report structure (per-repo sections, comparative tables, cross-cutting insights). Existing reporting steps don't handle multi-repo format.

informationProduced.flowDiagram:
```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Start] --> B[Init Process Principles]
```

newStepsRequired.name: gather-repository-information
newStepsRequired.purpose: Enumerate, validate, and gather metadata for all repositories in scope
outputs: Repository catalog with paths, validity status, basic metadata

newStepsRequired.name: investigate-across-repositories
newStepsRequired.purpose: Execute investigation across all repositories, gathering patterns, implementations, and examples per repo
outputs: Per-repository findings organized by investigation scope

newStepsRequired.name: compare-and-synthesize-findings
newStepsRequired.purpose: Compare findings across repositories, identify common patterns, differences, and generate cross-cutting insights
outputs: Comparative analysis with commonalities, differences, and recommendations

newStepsRequired.name: create-investigation-report
newStepsRequired.purpose: Generate comprehensive multi-repo investigation report in specified format
outputs: Investigation report with per-repo sections, comparative tables, and synthesis

feedbackLoops.trigger: Missing repository metadata or need to add/remove repositories from scope
Gaps in findings or need additional investigation in specific repos

decisionsMade: Reuse understand-context for initial context gathering - it handles parameter clarification well
Create new multi-repo category for specialized steps - no existing steps handle multi-repository orchestration
Use subprocess pattern for per-repo investigation - cleaner architecture, better isolation
Lightweight parent Step 2: just parse repo list, no cloning
Subprocess handles cloning on-demand (Step 1 in subprocess) - minimal disk usage
Subprocess handles cleanup (Step 5 in subprocess) - delete cloned repos, preserve local paths
Track subprocess info in repositories-list.json file, not parent memory - cleaner data locality
Step 4 is sync point where parent waits for all sub-processes to complete
Set approval checkpoint after context understanding and after synthesis before final report
Use camelCase for all parameter names per framework standards
8bc039a8-36ee-496e-b512-aaf171b0ebd7.notes: Template v3.0: On-demand cloning with automatic cleanup. Parent lightweight (parse/spawn/aggregate). Subprocess self-contained (clone→investigate→cleanup). 2 new multi-repo steps + 1 new subprocess template (6 steps, 4 new). 62.5% parent step reuse. Optimal disk usage.
